slack.why: Most scopes can be installed by any workspace member, but some need a workspace admin or an Enterprise org admin, and some only work fully for Marketplace-listed or internal apps.

options.task: Post messages as the app in channels
options.quote: When admin approval is not required, workspace members can install the app directly.
options.note: A workspace can still turn on admin approval for all apps, whatever the scopes.

options.task: Read message history in public channels
options.quote: This rate limit reduction will apply only to applications that are commercially distributed outside of the Marketplace (also called “unlisted” apps).
options.note: Not a block: unlisted commercial apps get 1 request per minute and 15 objects per call on conversations.history/replies; internal and Marketplace apps are unaffected.

options.task: Search workspace messages for an agent with the Real-time Search API
options.quote: The RTS API is available for directory-published apps and internal apps only.
options.note: Private channel, DM and file search scopes need both an admin and the end user to grant access; the legacy search:read scope is not accepted in the Marketplace.

options.task: Approve or decline Slack Connect channel invitations
options.quote: Since approval requires more authority than accepting invitations, apps with this feature can only be installed by a workspace owner or admin.

options.task: Search and inspect conversations across an Enterprise org
options.quote: The app requesting this scope must be installed by an Admin or Owner of an Enterprise organization.
options.note: admin.* scopes are on the list the Marketplace review says apps must not request, so this suits internal apps only.

standard.effect: Any workspace member can install the app and approve the scopes on the consent screen, unless the workspace requires admin approval.
standard.quote: When admin approval is not required, workspace members can install the app directly.

marketplace-review.effect: To use it at full strength for outside customers, list the app in the Slack Marketplace, which means a functional review of each scope.
marketplace-review.quote: Feedback from this part of the review generally takes up to 10 weeks for new submissions

workspace-admin.effect: A workspace owner or admin has to be the person who installs the app.
workspace-admin.quote: apps with this feature can only be installed by a workspace owner or admin.

enterprise-org-admin.effect: An Enterprise org admin or owner must install the app on the whole org, not on one workspace.
enterprise-org-admin.quote: Also, the app must be installed on the entire org, not on an individual workspace.

discord.why: Ordinary scopes and standard intents need no review, privileged gateway intents need a toggle and later Discord review, and several scopes are limited to approved partners.

options.task: Add a bot to a server to post and respond in channels
options.quote: they’ll be prompted to add the bot to a guild in which they have proper permissions.
options.note: The person adding the bot needs the right permissions in that server.

options.task: Register slash commands in a server
options.quote: applications.commands allows your app to add commands to a guild - included by default with the bot scope

options.task: List the servers a signed-in user belongs to
options.quote: guilds allows /users/@me/guilds to return basic information about all of a user’s guilds

options.task: Read the text of messages in server channels
options.quote: Like other privileged intents, MESSAGE_CONTENT must be approved for your app.
options.note: Without it, content fields come back empty except for DMs, mentions and the app's own messages.

options.task: Read a server's member list and member updates
options.quote: Currently, those intents include: GUILD_PRESENCES GUILD_MEMBERS MESSAGE_CONTENT

options.task: See a user's DMs and group DMs
options.quote: dm_channels.read allows your app to see information about the user’s DMs and group DMs - only available to approved partners

options.task: Connect to voice on a user's behalf
options.quote: voice allows your app to connect to voice on user’s behalf and see all the voice members - only available to approved partners

standard.effect: No Discord review; the user or server manager just authorizes the app.
standard.quote: Standard intents can be passed by default. You don’t need any additional permissions or configurations.

privileged-intent.effect: Toggle the intent in the Developer Portal, then apply for review once the app passes 10,000 users or needs verification at 100+ servers.
privileged-intent.quote: When an app has more than 10,000 unique users who can see your app across all the servers it’s in, it requires review for continued access to Privileged Intents.

approved-partner.effect: Ask a Discord account representative for partner access; without approval the OAuth flow may fail.
approved-partner.quote: To inquire about access about scopes that are only available to approved partners, speak to your Discord account representative

hubspot.why: Normal CRM scopes need only the installing user's consent, but Sensitive Data scopes need HubSpot approval for Marketplace apps, a Super admin to install, and an Enterprise account.

options.task: Read contact records
options.quote: Required scopes: scopes that must be authorized by the user and must be present in the scope query parameter in your app’s install URL for successful installation.
options.note: The installing user must have access to every requested scope, or a Super Admin must install.

options.task: Create and update contacts
options.quote: Create, delete, and make changes to [contacts]

options.task: Create and update deals
options.quote: Create, delete, or make changes to [deals]

options.task: Read custom object records
options.quote: Available to *Enterprise* accounts only.
options.note: No extra review, but only Enterprise HubSpot accounts can grant it.

options.task: Read Sensitive Data properties on contacts
options.quote: you’ll need to request access to specific sensitive scopes from HubSpot’s Ecosystem Quality team.
options.note: Applies to legacy public and Marketplace-bound apps; privately distributed apps can add the scope in config.

options.task: Read Highly Sensitive Data properties (e.g. SSN) on contacts
options.quote: If you want to access Highly Sensitive Data, you'll need [additional scopes]
options.note: The page's anchor labels highly sensitive scopes as beta; I could not find a separate process beyond the Sensitive Data one.

standard.effect: The installing user approves the scopes; no extra HubSpot approval is needed for the scope itself.
standard.quote: The user installing the app must have access to all requested scopes.

sensitive-approval.effect: For public or Marketplace apps, get the scopes allowlisted by HubSpot's Ecosystem Quality team, then have a Super admin in an Enterprise account authorize.
sensitive-approval.quote: Once you’ve notified your app users, a Super admin in their account will need to:

zoom.why: Each granular scope's suffix decides who can grant it: any user, an account admin, or an admin in a master account.

options.task: Create a meeting for the signed-in user
options.quote: `meeting:write:meeting` `meeting:write:meeting:admin`
options.note: The :admin variant of the same scope lets the app act for other users in the account.

options.task: List the signed-in user's meetings
options.quote: `meeting:read:list_meetings` `meeting:read:list_meetings:admin`

options.task: Get a meeting or webinar summary
options.quote: `meeting:read:summary` `meeting:read:summary:admin`

options.task: List a user's cloud recordings
options.quote: `cloud_recording:read:list_user_recordings`

options.task: List all users in the Zoom account
options.quote: `user:read:list_users:admin`
options.note: Only an :admin variant is listed for this endpoint.

options.task: Get meeting participant reports
options.quote: `report:read:list_meeting_participants:admin`
options.note: Only :admin and :master variants are listed for this endpoint.

options.task: Create meetings in sub accounts of a master account
options.quote: `meeting:write:meeting:master`

user.effect: Any individual user can authorize the scope for their own data.
user.quote: Access scope without an access value indicates the scope is tied to data claims that can be granted by individual users.

admin.effect: Build an admin-managed app and have an account admin add it for all users.
admin.quote: admin - The access scope is tied to data claims that can only be granted by users with administrator role.

master.effect: An admin in a master account must grant it, for master and sub-account setups only.
master.quote: master - The access scope is tied to data claims that can only be granted by users with administrator role in a master account in the master-sub account set up.

quickbooks.why: Core accounting and payments scopes are open to every app, but premium API scopes (projects, custom fields, sales tax, payroll compensation) only appear for paid Silver, Gold or Platinum partners.

options.task: Create and send invoices
options.quote: Grants access to the QuickBooks Online Accounting API, which focuses on accounting data.

options.task: Read customers, bills and financial reports
options.quote: Grants access to the QuickBooks Online Accounting API, which focuses on accounting data.

options.task: Charge a card or bank account
options.quote: If it only needs access to payments data, select the payments scope.
options.note: I could not confirm on official Intuit pages that the payments scope needs its own approval; third-party guides say it is US only.

options.task: Create and manage projects
options.quote: Grants access to read and write Project data.
options.note: Projects API is listed as a premium API.

options.task: Read and write custom field definitions
options.quote: Grants access to read and write Custom Fields definitions data.
options.note: Custom Fields API is listed as a premium API.

options.task: Calculate sales tax on transactions
options.quote: Grants access to the Sales Tax API.
options.note: Sales Tax API is listed as a premium API.

options.task: Read payroll pay types
options.quote: Compensation data can only be queried for customers using QuickBooks Payroll.
options.note: Payroll Compensation API is listed as a premium API and is not available in sandbox.

standard.effect: Pass the App Assessment Questionnaire to get production keys, then the customer approves the scopes.
standard.quote: Note: The Show Credentials switch appears only after the App Assessment Questionnaire is approved.

premium-tier.effect: Subscribe to the paid Silver tier or higher, then enable the restricted scopes on the app's Permissions page.
premium-tier.quote: Premium APIs are part of the Intuit App Partner Program and are available to Silver, Gold, and Platinum partners only. Builder tier partners do not have access to premium APIs.
